notes.title: Verlet Ascend 2.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We have a small update that addresses some feedback and issues that we got from the release of 2.0. We hope that you are enjoying the 2.0 content.

Changes In this version;

-Made the first level shorter.
-Throwing knifes now aim and move towards enemies.
-Boss scene deadzone start speed increased.
-Forager upgrade spawns more carrots.
-Fixed most of the inconsistencies on terrain destruction.
-Less levels to complete the game.
-It is now easier to unlock new upgrades.

Please feel free to share with us your thoughts, ideas or if you face any bugs in Steam Community Forums  or as a reply to this post. Thank you!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Update!
notes.notes:
We are participating in Steam Next Fest, which will start on February 6 and last 7 days!

We have great new features and content planned for the game, and some are already implemented, we have updated our demo to better show our games full potential to get ready for Steam Next Fest, check out our game and keep giving us your feedback!

Thank you for your continuing support.
